links.outcome: Plantar fascia thickness measurement reliability of ChatGPT-4 versus experienced clinician on same MRI data
links.effect: Clinician ICC 0.983-0.989 vs ChatGPT-4 ICC 0.391-0.432; ChatGPT-4 mean 6.47 mm vs clinician 4.20 mm; thin fascia MAE 2.70 mm, MRE 77.17% (blinded).
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 demonstrated lower reliability in plantar fascia thickness measurements compared to an experienced clinician, with increased error rates in thin structures.

screen.reason: Empirical study evaluating the diagnostic measurement accuracy and reliability of multimodal ChatGPT-4 on retrospective foot MRI images compared to an experienced clinician; it does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
